REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_buy_bond_1 = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

    #random_in_global_list = {
    #    variable = central_bank_debt_variable_list_ordered_1
    #    save_scope_as = seller
    #}

	random_country = {
		limit = {
			has_central_bank_SS_BS_GS_GES_NISO = yes #has bc
			has_financial_center = yes #has fc
			remaining_debt > 0
			zz_ef_bl_room > 0
			market_owner_is_root_4 = yes
			central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent < 0.75
			not = {
				has_modifier = country_credit_rating_D
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = seller
	}

    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:buyer.ai_selle_bond_maturity_yers_time_1 = 0
            exists = scope:seller
            scope:seller = {
                not = {
                    this = root
                }
            }
            gold_reserves_var > gold_reserves_10 #reserve sup à 10% de la reserve
			#bond_quantity_scripted >  0
        }

        random_list = {
            1 = { #5Years
                scope:seller = {
                    scope:buyer = {
                        # Pour les liste du vendeur
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_buyer_country_1
                            target = prev
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_1
                            target = scope:seller #prev
                        }

						#seller
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_1
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                       #seller save scope
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_1
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                        ######
                        #quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_bond_quantity_1
                            value = bond_quantity_scripted
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_quantity_purchasing_1
                            value = var:ai_bond_quantity_1
                        }

                        #interret lors de l'achat
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_purchasing_1
                            value = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #valeur de la quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_1
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_1
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_1 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_1
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }

                        #interet total
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_1
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_1
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_1 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_1
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_1
                            multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #interet total à terme
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_1
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_1
                            multiply = 5
                        }

                        #interet par mois
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_1
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_1
                            divide = 12
                        }

                        add_treasury = {
                            subtract = var:ai_total_bond_value_1
                        }

                        interest_per_month_from_foreign_debt_investment = yes

                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_maturity_time_1
                            value = 5
                        }

                        #demare le on_action
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_buy_bond_1_on
                            value = 1
                        }

                    #################
                    #notification
                    every_country = {
                        limit  = {
                            is_player = yes
                        }
                        save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_1_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_1
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }

                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_3_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_3
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_buy_bond_4 = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

    #random_in_global_list = {
    #    variable = central_bank_debt_variable_list_ordered_1
    #    save_scope_as = seller
    #}

	random_country = {
		limit = {
			has_central_bank_SS_BS_GS_GES_NISO = yes #has bc
			has_financial_center = yes #has fc
			remaining_debt > 0
			zz_ef_bl_room > 0
			market_owner_is_root_4 = yes
			central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent < 0.75
			not = {
				has_modifier = country_credit_rating_D
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = seller
	}

    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:buyer.ai_selle_bond_maturity_yers_time_4 = 0
            exists = scope:seller
            scope:seller = {
                not = {
                    this = root
                }
            }
            gold_reserves_var > gold_reserves_10 #reserve sup à 10% de la reserve
			#bond_quantity_scripted >  0
        }

        random_list = {
            1 = { #5Years
                scope:seller = {
                    scope:buyer = {
                        # Pour les liste du vendeur
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_buyer_country_4
                            target = prev
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_4
                            target = scope:seller #prev
                        }

						#seller
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_4
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                       #seller save scope
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_4
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                        ######
                        #quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_bond_quantity_4
                            value = bond_quantity_scripted
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_quantity_purchasing_4
                            value = var:ai_bond_quantity_4
                        }

                        #interret lors de l'achat
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_purchasing_4
                            value = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #valeur de la quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_4
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_4
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_4 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_4
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }

                        #interet total
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_4 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #interet total à terme
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_4
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_4
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_4
                            multiply = 5
                        }

                        #interet par mois
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_4
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_4
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_4
                            divide = 12
                        }

                        add_treasury = {
                            subtract = var:ai_total_bond_value_4
                        }

                        interest_per_month_from_foreign_debt_investment = yes

                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_maturity_time_4
                            value = 5
                        }

                        #demare le on_action
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_buy_bond_4_on
                            value = 1
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #notification
                    every_country = {
                        limit  = {
                            is_player = yes
                        }
                        save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_4_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_4
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
            1 = { #10Years
                scope:seller = {
                    scope:buyer = {
                        # Pour les liste du vendeur
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_buyer_country_4
                            target = prev
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_4
                            target = scope:seller #prev
                        }

                       #seller save scope
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_4
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                        ######
                        #quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_bond_quantity_4
                            value = bond_quantity_scripted
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_quantity_purchasing_4
                            value = var:ai_bond_quantity_4
                        }

                        #interret lors de l'achat
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_purchasing_4
                            value = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
                        }

                        #valeur de la quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_4
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_4
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_4 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_4
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }

                        #interet total
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_4 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_4
                            multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
                        }

                        #interet total à terme
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_4
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_4
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_4
                            multiply = 10
                        }

                        #interet par mois
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_4
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_4
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_4
                            divide = 12
                        }

                        add_treasury = {
                            subtract = var:ai_total_bond_value_4
                        }

                        interest_per_month_from_foreign_debt_investment = yes

                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_maturity_time_4
                            value = 10
                        }

                        #demare le on_action
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_buy_bond_4_on
                            value = 1
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #notification
                    every_country = {
                        limit  = {
                            is_player = yes
                        }
                        save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_4_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_4
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_6_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_6
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_buy_bond_7 = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

    #random_in_global_list = {
    #    variable = central_bank_debt_variable_list_ordered_1
    #    save_scope_as = seller
    #}

	random_country = {
		limit = {
			has_central_bank_SS_BS_GS_GES_NISO = yes #has bc
			has_financial_center = yes #has fc
			remaining_debt > 0
			zz_ef_bl_room > 0
			market_owner_is_root_4 = yes
			central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent < 0.75
			not = {
				has_modifier = country_credit_rating_D
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = seller
	}

    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:buyer.ai_selle_bond_maturity_yers_time_7 = 0
            exists = scope:seller
            scope:seller = {
                not = {
                    this = root
                }
            }
            gold_reserves_var > gold_reserves_10 #reserve sup à 10% de la reserve
			#bond_quantity_scripted >  0
        }

        random_list = {
            1 = { #5Years
                scope:seller = {
                    scope:buyer = {
                        # Pour les liste du vendeur
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_buyer_country_7
                            target = prev
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_7
                            target = scope:seller #prev
                        }

						#seller
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_7
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                       #seller save scope
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_7
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                        ######
                        #quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_bond_quantity_7
                            value = bond_quantity_scripted
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_quantity_purchasing_7
                            value = var:ai_bond_quantity_7
                        }

                        #interret lors de l'achat
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_purchasing_7
                            value = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #valeur de la quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_7
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_7
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_7 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_7
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }

                        #interet total
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_7 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #interet total à terme
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_7
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_7
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_7
                            multiply = 5
                        }

                        #interet par mois
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_7
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_7
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_7
                            divide = 12
                        }

                        add_treasury = {
                            subtract = var:ai_total_bond_value_7
                        }

                        interest_per_month_from_foreign_debt_investment = yes

                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_maturity_time_7
                            value = 5
                        }

                        #demare le on_action
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_buy_bond_7_on
                            value = 1
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #notification
                    every_country = {
                        limit  = {
                            is_player = yes
                        }
                        save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_7_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_7
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
            1 = { #10Years
                scope:seller = {
                    scope:buyer = {
                        # Pour les liste du vendeur
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_buyer_country_7
                            target = prev
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_7
                            target = scope:seller #prev
                        }

                       #seller save scope
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_7
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                        ######
                        #quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_bond_quantity_7
                            value = bond_quantity_scripted
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_quantity_purchasing_7
                            value = var:ai_bond_quantity_7
                        }

                        #interret lors de l'achat
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_purchasing_7
                            value = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
                        }

                        #valeur de la quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_7
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_7
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_7 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_7
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }

                        #interet total
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_7 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_7
                            multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
                        }

                        #interet total à terme
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_7
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_7
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_7
                            multiply = 10
                        }

                        #interet par mois
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_7
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_7
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_7
                            divide = 12
                        }

                        add_treasury = {
                            subtract = var:ai_total_bond_value_7
                        }

                        interest_per_month_from_foreign_debt_investment = yes

                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_maturity_time_7
                            value = 10
                        }

                        #demare le on_action
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_buy_bond_7_on
                            value = 1
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #notification
                    every_country = {
                        limit  = {
                            is_player = yes
                        }
                        save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_7_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_7
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_9_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_9
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_buy_bond_10 = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

    #random_in_global_list = {
    #    variable = central_bank_debt_variable_list_ordered_1
    #    save_scope_as = seller
    #}

	random_country = {
		limit = {
			has_central_bank_SS_BS_GS_GES_NISO = yes #has bc
			has_financial_center = yes #has fc
			remaining_debt > 0
			zz_ef_bl_room > 0
			market_owner_is_root_4 = yes
			central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent < 0.75
			not = {
				has_modifier = country_credit_rating_D
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = seller
	}

    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:buyer.ai_selle_bond_maturity_yers_time_10 = 0
            exists = scope:seller
            scope:seller = {
                not = {
                    this = root
                }
            }
            gold_reserves_var > gold_reserves_10 #reserve sup à 10% de la reserve
			#bond_quantity_scripted >  0
        }

        random_list = {
            1 = { #5Years
                scope:seller = {
                    scope:buyer = {
                        # Pour les liste du vendeur
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_buyer_country_10
                            target = prev
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_10
                            target = scope:seller #prev
                        }

						#seller
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_10
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                       #seller save scope
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_10
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                        ######
                        #quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_bond_quantity_10
                            value = bond_quantity_scripted
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_quantity_purchasing_10
                            value = var:ai_bond_quantity_10
                        }

                        #interret lors de l'achat
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_purchasing_10
                            value = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #valeur de la quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_10
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_10
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_10 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_10
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }

                        #interet total
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_10 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_5Y
                        }

                        #interet total à terme
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_10
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_10
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_10
                            multiply = 5
                        }

                        #interet par mois
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_10
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_10
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_10
                            divide = 12
                        }

                        add_treasury = {
                            subtract = var:ai_total_bond_value_10
                        }

                        interest_per_month_from_foreign_debt_investment = yes

                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_maturity_time_10
                            value = 5
                        }

                        #demare le on_action
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_buy_bond_10_on
                            value = 1
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #notification
                    every_country = {
                        limit  = {
                            is_player = yes
                        }
                        save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_10_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_10
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
            1 = { #10Years
                scope:seller = {
                    scope:buyer = {
                        # Pour les liste du vendeur
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_buyer_country_10
                            target = prev
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_10
                            target = scope:seller #prev
                        }

                       #seller save scope
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_seller_country_general_10
                            value = scope:seller
                        }

                        ######
                        #quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_bond_quantity_10
                            value = bond_quantity_scripted
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_quantity_purchasing_10
                            value = var:ai_bond_quantity_10
                        }

                        #interret lors de l'achat
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_purchasing_10
                            value = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
                        }

                        #valeur de la quantité
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_10
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_10
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_10 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_total_bond_value_10
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }

                        #interet total
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            value = 1
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            multiply = var:ai_bond_quantity_10 #bond quantité
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            multiply = scope:seller.bond_price
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_calculated_10
                            multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
                        }

                        #interet total à terme
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_10
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_10
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_at_term_calculated_10
                            multiply = 10
                        }

                        #interet par mois
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_10
                            value = var:ai_interest_calculated_10
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = ai_interest_per_month_calculated_10
                            divide = 12
                        }

                        add_treasury = {
                            subtract = var:ai_total_bond_value_10
                        }

                        interest_per_month_from_foreign_debt_investment = yes

                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_maturity_time_10
                            value = 10
                        }

                        #demare le on_action
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ai_buy_bond_10_on
                            value = 1
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #notification
                    every_country = {
                        limit  = {
                            is_player = yes
                        }
                        save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
                        }
                        scope:is_player_for_notification = {
                            post_notification = ai_selle_bond_maturity_10_message
                        }
                    }

                    #################
                    #ajout à la liste des acheteur
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = central_bank_debt_buyer_list_10
                        target = scope:buyer
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:central_bank_debt_variable_list = {
	#changement de princuipe ce n'azi plus la dette de la bank qui compter
	#modifier l'odre de pays acheter en premier à l'avenir avec un score ?

    every_country = {
        limit = {
			gold_loaned_to_central_bank < total_debt_80 #tout les pays avec une dette non comblé à au minimum 80% sont éligible
			central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent < 0.75 #donc besoin investissement

			has_central_bank_SS_BS_GS_GES_NISO = yes
			zz_ef_bl_room > 0
			not = {
				#market_owner_is_root
				any_scope_state = {
					is_production_method_active = {
						building_type = building_bank
						production_method = pm_no_metal_consuption
					}
					not = {
						is_production_method_active = {
							building_type = building_bank
							production_method = pm_no_subject_currency_type
						}
					}
				}
				has_modifier = country_credit_rating_D
			} 
        }
        root = {
            add_to_variable_list = {
                name = central_bank_debt_variable_list
                target = prev
            }
        }
    }
    root = {
        if = {
            clear_variable_list = list_before_order
            every_in_list = {
                variable = central_bank_debt_variable_list
                root = {
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = list_before_order
                        target = prev
                    }
                }
            }
            clear_global_variable_list = central_bank_debt_variable_list_ordered_1
			ordered_in_list = {
				variable = list_before_order
				order_by = remaining_debt
				max = 100
				check_range_bounds = no
				root = {
					add_to_global_variable_list = {
						name = central_bank_debt_variable_list_ordered_1
						target = prev
					}
				}
			}
        }
        clear_variable_list = central_bank_debt_variable_list
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_privat_bank_bond_1_renforcement = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

	random_in_list = {
		variable = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_1
		save_scope_as = seller_1
	}

	#renforcement
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:seller_1
			scope:seller_1.remaining_debt > 0
			scope:seller_1.zz_ef_bl_room > 0
        }
		scope:seller_1 = {
			scope:buyer = {
				random_in_list = {
					variable = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_1
     			   	save_scope_as = buyer_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_1
					add = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}

				#valeur de la quantité
				set_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1_new
					value = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1_new
					multiply = scope:seller.bond_price_in_gold
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1
					add = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1_new
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1_new > 0
					}
					#interet total -> recalcule total
					set_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_1
						value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_1
						multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
					}
				}
				add_investment_pool = {
					subtract = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1_new
				}
 			}

			#################
			#notification
			every_country = {
				limit  = {
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_selle_bond_maturity_1_message
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:buyer = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_buy_bond_maturity_1_message
				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_1
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_1
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_1
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_1
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_1
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_1

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_1
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_1
    }
}

				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_4
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_4
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_4
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_4
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_4
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_4

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_4
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_4
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_privat_bank_bond_5_renforcement = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

	random_in_list = {
		variable = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_5
		save_scope_as = seller_5
	}

	#renforcement
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:seller_5
			scope:seller_5.remaining_debt > 0
			scope:seller_5.zz_ef_bl_room > 0
        }
		scope:seller_5 = {
			scope:buyer = {
				random_in_list = {
					variable = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_5
     			   	save_scope_as = buyer_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_5
					add = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}

				#valeur de la quantité
				set_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5_new
					value = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5_new
					multiply = scope:seller.bond_price_in_gold
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5
					add = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5_new
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5_new > 0
					}
					#interet total -> recalcule total
					set_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_5
						value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_5
						multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
					}
				}
				add_investment_pool = {
					subtract = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5_new
				}
 			}

			#################
			#notification
			every_country = {
				limit  = {
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_selle_bond_maturity_5_message
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:buyer = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_buy_bond_maturity_5_message
				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_5
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_5
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_5
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_5
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_5
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_5

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_5
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_5
    }
}

				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_11_new
					multiply = scope:seller.bond_price_in_gold
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_11
					add = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_11_new
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_11_new > 0
					}
					#interet total -> recalcule total
					set_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_11
						value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_11
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_11
						multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
					}
				}
				add_investment_pool = {
					subtract = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_11_new
				}
 			}

			#################
			#notification
			every_country = {
				limit  = {
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_selle_bond_maturity_11_message
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:buyer = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_buy_bond_maturity_11_message
				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_11
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_11
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_11
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_11
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_11
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_11

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_11
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_11
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_privat_bank_bond_12_renforcement = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

	random_in_list = {
		variable = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_12
		save_scope_as = seller_12
	}

	#renforcement
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:seller_12
			scope:seller_12.remaining_debt > 0
			scope:seller_12.zz_ef_bl_room > 0
        }
		scope:seller_12 = {
			scope:buyer = {
				random_in_list = {
					variable = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_12
     			   	save_scope_as = buyer_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_12
					add = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}

				#valeur de la quantité
				set_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12_new
					value = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12_new
					multiply = scope:seller.bond_price_in_gold
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12
					add = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12_new
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12_new > 0
					}
					#interet total -> recalcule total
					set_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_12
						value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_12
						multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
					}
				}
				add_investment_pool = {
					subtract = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12_new
				}
 			}

			#################
			#notification
			every_country = {
				limit  = {
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_selle_bond_maturity_12_message
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:buyer = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_buy_bond_maturity_12_message
				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_12
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_12
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_12
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_12
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_12
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_12

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_12
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_12
    }
}

		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_17
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_17
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_17
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_17

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_17
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_17
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_privat_bank_bond_18_renforcement = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

	random_in_list = {
		variable = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_18
		save_scope_as = seller_18
	}

	#renforcement
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:seller_18
			scope:seller_18.remaining_debt > 0
			scope:seller_18.zz_ef_bl_room > 0
        }
		scope:seller_18 = {
			scope:buyer = {
				random_in_list = {
					variable = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_18
     			   	save_scope_as = buyer_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_18
					add = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}

				#valeur de la quantité
				set_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18_new
					value = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18_new
					multiply = scope:seller.bond_price_in_gold
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18
					add = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18_new
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18_new > 0
					}
					#interet total -> recalcule total
					set_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_18
						value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_18
						multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
					}
				}
				add_investment_pool = {
					subtract = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18_new
				}
 			}

			#################
			#notification
			every_country = {
				limit  = {
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_selle_bond_maturity_18_message
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:buyer = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_buy_bond_maturity_18_message
				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_18
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_18
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_18
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_18
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_18
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_18

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_18
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_18
    }
}

					}
					#interet total -> recalcule total
					set_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_24
						value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_24
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_24
						multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
					}
				}
				add_investment_pool = {
					subtract = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_24_new
				}
 			}

			#################
			#notification
			every_country = {
				limit  = {
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_selle_bond_maturity_24_message
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:buyer = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_buy_bond_maturity_24_message
				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_24
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_24
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_24
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_24
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_24
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_24

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_24
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_24
    }
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:ai_privat_bank_bond_25_renforcement = {
    root = {
        save_scope_as = buyer
    }

	random_in_list = {
		variable = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_25
		save_scope_as = seller_25
	}

	#renforcement
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:seller_25
			scope:seller_25.remaining_debt > 0
			scope:seller_25.zz_ef_bl_room > 0
        }
		scope:seller_25 = {
			scope:buyer = {
				random_in_list = {
					variable = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_25
     			   	save_scope_as = buyer_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_25
					add = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}

				#valeur de la quantité
				set_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25_new
					value = bond_quantity_scripted_privat_bank
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25_new
					multiply = scope:seller.bond_price_in_gold
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25
					add = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25_new
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25_new > 0
					}
					#interet total -> recalcule total
					set_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_25
						value = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_25
						multiply = scope:seller.interest_value_10Y
					}
				}
				add_investment_pool = {
					subtract = var:ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25_new
				}
 			}

			#################
			#notification
			every_country = {
				limit  = {
					is_player = yes
				}
				save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:seller = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_selle_bond_maturity_25_message
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:buyer = scope:is_player_for_notification
				}
				scope:is_player_for_notification = {
					post_notification = ai_privat_bank_renforcement_buy_bond_maturity_25_message
				}
			}

			central_bank_interest_refund_per_year_in_gold = yes
 		}
 	}

	#clear
    if = {
        limit = {
			not = {
				exists = scope:seller_25
			}
        }
		#Reset variable
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_buyer_slot_25
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_quantity_25
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_bond_value_25
			value = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = ai_privat_bank_interest_calculated_25
			value = 0
		}

		#Reset list
		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_buyer_country_25

		clear_variable_list = ai_privat_bank_seller_country_general_25
		clear_variable_list =  central_bank_debt_privat_bank_buyer_list_25
    }
}
